data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD)
* **Context:** worktree-20260522-142331, sub-agent execution of task 4cf2-64e9-da0c-48e6

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior
Per task 4cf2 and gap-analysis 1/3 amendment: aws-setup-bucket.sh's write_config_key MUST respect a config-file override env var (DSO_CONFIG_FILE or similar) so that tests writing to mock environments do NOT mutate the real .claude/dso-config.conf. Tests must use mktemp -d for their config file via DSO_TELEMETRY_LEDGER_DIR and similar overrides.

#### Actual Behavior
During the GREEN implementation sub-agent's test run, .claude/dso-config.conf gained a `review_telemetry.bucket_name=dso-telemetry-123456789012` line — this is a real-config mutation from a mocked test run. Either (a) the script writes to .claude/dso-config.conf unconditionally with no override hook, OR (b) the test harness doesn't shim the path correctly. Reverted manually before committing.

### 4. Action History
- Dispatched 4cf2 sub-agent which ran the test suite via PATH-stubbed aws CLI
- Sub-agent reported 34/34 tests pass GREEN
- Inspection of post-run git status showed an unexpected modification to .claude/dso-config.conf
- Reverted via `git checkout HEAD -- .claude/dso-config.conf` before committing

### 7. Additional Details
Remediation: add DSO_CONFIG_FILE env var override to write_config_key (and read_config_key) in plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-bucket.sh. Add an AC to task 4cf2 (or a follow-up) that the test for write_config_key (cases 6, 7, 12) uses mktemp -d config file via the override env var and confirms the real .claude/dso-config.conf is unchanged after the test run.
data.title: aws-setup-bucket.sh test: write_config_key writes to real .claude/dso-config.conf during test runs (isolation defect)
